acceptanceCriteria: The alert is emitted once per ticket and applied-config digest; a config change or a different ticket alerts again (test)
Launch behaviour without the block is unchanged; focused dispatch tests pass
body: Found while building V1-1852 (#1157). When ATR-V0-133's launch-time recheck finds a ticket's rendered argv unsafe, the session launches without the carry-over block and emits one alert per launch. A ticket that keeps relaunching under the same config repeats the alert every time. Expected: one alert per (ticket, config digest).
